page.overview:
What is Enishi?

Enishi is an island located in the New World. It is a non-affiliated nation, independent of the World Government, and is historically notable for having provided crucial aid to the giant kingdom of Elbaph during a severe famine.

Enishi is characterized by high coastal cliffs and a sprawling, verdant mountain range. The island's primary port lies along the coastline and is distinguished by numerous wooden homes built seamlessly into the craggy landscape. Several docks extend into the water.

63 years ago, Enishi played a pivotal role in supporting Elbaph during a devastating famine, responding to a diplomatic appeal from King Harald. The aid provided by Enishi and other nations helped sustain the giant kingdom through this difficult period.

At least 42 years ago, Enishi faced direct interference from the World Government. A group of agents was dispatched to the island for reasons that remain unknown, taking several residents hostage. By coincidence, King Harald had returned to the area at the same time, seeking to repay the island's previous generosity. When Harald confronted the agents and protested their treatment of Enishi's citizens, the lead agent warned him to stay out of the matter, citing potential political repercussions for Elbaph's relationship with the World Government. The situation escalated when the agent shot one of the hostages, prompting Harald to leap from his ship and destroy the assailants' vessel. While Harald's actions succeeded in saving Enishi's people, his defiance of the World Government led to a series of government-sanctioned publications that tarnished his reputation.
